    • generate

      public EAxFilter.EAxFilterResult generate(Path inputProblem, Path outputDirectory, EAxFilter.EAxFilterOptions options, int timeoutSeconds) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Runs e_axfilter against a complete TPTP problem. The input problem is copied into the output directory because e_axfilter generates its output files alongside the input file. The output directory must be empty so that stale files from a previous run cannot be mistaken for newly generated problems.
      Parameters:
      inputProblem - complete TPTP problem containing its conjecture
      outputDirectory - unique empty directory for this filter run
      options - e_axfilter command-line options
      timeoutSeconds - maximum wall-clock runtime
      Returns:
      process information and generated TPTP problem files
      Throws:
      IOException - if files cannot be prepared or the process cannot start
      InterruptedException - if the calling thread is interrupted
